question:
If A is an acute angle, the simplified form of 

 ({cos (pi - A).cot ( {frac{pi )/(2) + A} )cos ( - A)}}{{tan (pi + A)tan ( {frac{{3pi }}{2} + A} )sin (2pi - A)}}is :
solution:
**Concept used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b596874c1972cd4f67ef54e894db9555ae2aeaf543d54f4a089d828a31b749de.png] 

**Formula used:**

 
• cos (π - θ) = - cos θ
 
• cot (90 + θ) = - tan θ 
 
• cos (-θ) = cos θ 
 
• tan (π + θ) = tan θ 
 
• tan (3π/2 + θ) = - cot θ 
 
• sin (2π - θ) = - sin θ

 

**Calculation:**

 ({cos (π - A).cot ( {frac{π )/(2) + A} )cos ( - A)}}{{tan (π + A)tan ( {frac{{3π }}{2} + A} )sin (2π - A)}}

By using the above formula

 frac{{ (-cos A) . ( {-tan A} ) . cos A}}{{tan A . (-cot A ). (-sin A)}}

⇒ (cos A . cos A)/(cot A . sin A)

But, cos θ / sin θ = cot θ 

⇒ cot A. cos A/ cot A

⇒ cos A

**∴ The correct answer is cos A.**
